'''2000 GenCon Sealed Deck (10 August)''' was a Star Wars CCG sealed deck held at GenCon, Milwaukee, Wisconsin on 10 August 2000. [[Brian Hunter]] won it. It is known from Clayton Atkin's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d6666">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-16-clayton-does-gencon-2000d6666/ clayton-does-gencon-2000], DeckTech (Clayton "TheDohMan" Atkin, 16 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-16-clayton-does-gencon-2000d6666/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[2000 North American Continental Championship]].

* '''Date:''' 10 August 2000
* '''Site:''' GenCon, Milwaukee, Wisconsin
* '''Format:''' [[Sealed Deck]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Brian Hunter]]
